title: The Bright Machine
author: O. M. Villalobos
blurb: Ines Lockridge, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
